title: Mixed Event — A Bright Future!! — Episode7 The First Step

meta.Event Outline: Bit by bit, the members of Leo/need continue preparations for their first show together. Their new song is coming along well, and all that's left is for Ichika to add her lyrics. She's determined to express the feelings that Saki put into the composition, but will it be so easy...?

rows.Line: The day of the show
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, they're starting to let everyone in!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, they are...
Six, seven... I see maybe ten people?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So not too many. I was expecting to see much more for a second there.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, the show isn't starting for a while.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The bigger names go on stage starting about halfway through, so it's a good bet that more will show up then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
So we shouldn't expect to see too big a crowd when it's our turn.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd say so too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, that's good to hear...
But I am starting to get a little nervous.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, my heart's really starting to pound!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Just try to relax. We played in front of way more people during the STANDOUT show, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But that was when we were absolutely desperate...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We even have an original song to worry about this time. Do you think it'll go over well with them...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, Ichi, it has to...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We all worked so hard on it and practiced so much. I'm sure that they'll see that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She says that while her hands shake.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, just try to relax.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's our very first show, so no one's going to be judging us or expecting us to do something we can't.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But that also gives us much more freedom. We can show them what we've got while playing just the way we like.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And considering how much we practiced, I'm sure we'll be able to do just that. It may be a small crowd, but we can still try to reach each of them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So don't worry!
If push comes to shove, I'll take over and really get them going!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's Saki Tenma for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Here, huddle up!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huddle?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's all put our hands together and get ourselves psyched up for this!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sure, why not?
A lot of other bands do it too, so...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, then...
Let's give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay♪
Alright, everyone make a peace sign!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A peace sign?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Like this and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
See? It turns into a star!
Like our band name♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
Okay, Ichi!
Lead the way♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Everyone, let's do our best.
Let's show this crowd what we're about and tell them exactly how we feel!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are you ready?!

rows.Speaker: Everybody
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hey, that last band was pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Who's next...? Leo/need?
Never heard of them.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Wait, I actually might have. Didn't they open for STANDOUT that one time?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Whoa, say what?
That means they're pretty good, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hello, we're Leo/need!
We're so honored to be playing here for you all today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'd like to start with a cover of a Miku song that we as a band really love.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We hope you enjoy it!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hey, I know this song!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Sick bass line!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah, they played this when they opened for STANDOUT! They've improved a lot since then too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. They seem to like it so far...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Just gotta keep this up through our first two songs. Warm them up by playing something they all know...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Yeah, let's really get them going!)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Hinomori looks like she's having fun.
I've never seen her smile like this while on stage before.
Excuse me. Do you still have any same-day tickets available?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Yes, there's still plenty.
Which band are you here to see? Huh?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Leo/need, of course.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you!
These Miku songs are what brought us together as a band, so I'm glad you liked them!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we'd like to end with an original song.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
An original song?
So something they made?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Aww, I kinda wanted to hear another Miku song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: To tell you the truth, it took us quite a long time to reach the point of being able to perform on stage like this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There were times when we doubted ourselves and thought about giving up, but we're here today because we have each other. Because we're Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're still just getting started as a band, but this song represents all the hard work we put into getting to this stage.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Please, we hope you enjoy it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Here we go. Our song...!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Not a very catchy intro...
But that girl on the bass is off the hook.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: The lyrics are kinda dull too. Been there, done that, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh no, we're starting to lose them...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(But this is to be expected.
Most of these people are here to see much more famous bands.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Unlike the Miku songs we just played, this is something no one's ever heard of by a no-name band. It's only natural that they lose interest.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(We put everything into this song.
We can't give up. Not now!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Shiho even said that this song is Leo/need! This is us!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We can do it! I know we can!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We have to reach them. We have to give this song everything we have!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hey, this isn't bad...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: They're a bit spotty, but they're really giving it 100%.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Yeah, this is nice. Hinomori's band's doing pretty well for themselves.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: It's hard to believe that this is their very first show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our first song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for hearing our very first song! Thank you all very much!
